description: Use to watch a person rather than one account. Puts every account of a saved creator identity (`identityId`, optional `note`) on your watchlist, each as its own entry with its own baselines; list_watchlist then groups them under the identity in `byIdentity`. Accounts added to the identity later are not watched until this is called again. Nothing is fetched. No cost to call.
name: watch_creator_identity
title: Watch Creator Identity
